footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Ategrity Specialty Insurance: after $2.1M attributable to noncontrolling interests, $890K of preferred dividends. The income statement doesn't separate operating from non-operating items in a form this page can follow, so costs and expenses are shown in total down to pre-tax income.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 23.4% to $424M in 2025. Operating income rose 44.7% to $95.9M, a 22.6% margin.
Net income rose 55.3% to $73.1M, or $1.58 per share. Operating cash flow was $147M and free cash flow $141M, versus $125M; Ategrity Specialty Insurance returned $2.7M through buybacks.
